title: Microsoft declares ‘Code Red’ after huge Outlook outage

claims.claim: Bu ay yaşanan Exchange Online ve Microsoft Outlook kesintisi, Reuters'ın haberine göre yazılım devinin şirket içinde olağandışı bir "Kod Kırmızı" ilan etmesine yol açtı.

evidence.quote: This month’s Exchange Online and Microsoft Outlook outage has prompted the software giant to declare an unusual “Code Red” internally, Reuters reports.
According to internal memos reviewed by Reuters, Microsoft has declared a “Code Red” overhaul of its engineering response practices after the November 12 outage

claims.claim: Yaklaşık 24 saat süren kesinti milyonlarca müşterinin e-posta erişimini engelledi.

evidence.quote: The nearly 24-hour outage took down email for millions of customers

claims.claim: Kesinti, Temmuz ayından bu yana Microsoft 365 ağ geçidi sunucularında bulunan bir hatadan kaynaklandı.

evidence.quote: triggered by a bug that had been sitting on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers since July without any impact to servers.

The nearly 24-hour outage took down email for millions of customers, and was triggered by a bug that had been sitting on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers since July without any impact to servers.
The company’s post-incident report, dated November 20, attributed the downtime to an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July, which caused lock contention in the gateway processes.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Core başkanı Jason Henderson, kesintinin Microsoft müşterileri tarihindeki en önemli kesinti olduğunu açıkladı.

evidence.quote: In a memo to the teams responsible for Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 Core president Jason Henderson revealed the outage was the most significant in history for Microsoft’s customers.
Per the memos, Microsoft 365 Core President Jason Henderson described the outage as having the most customer impact in the history of Exchange Online.

claims.claim: Microsoft gelecekteki kesintileri bir saat içinde çözme hedefine sahip olup mühendislerin sorunları teşhis etmesine yardımcı olmak için yapay zeka ajanları görevlendirecek.

evidence.quote: Microsoft now has a target of resolving future outages within an hour, and will reportedly deploy AI agents to help engineers diagnose issues.

claims.claim: Microsoft, Microsoft 365 hizmetlerinden sorumlu mühendislik grubuyla günlük toplantılar ve haftalık incelemeler gerçekleştiriyor.

evidence.quote: Microsoft is now holding daily meetings with the engineering group responsible for Microsoft 365 services, alongside weekly reviews.

claims.claim: Microsoft mühendisleri kesinti sırasında en fazla 1.000 katılımcıya ulaşan bir köprü çağrısı yürüttü.

evidence.quote: I reported last week that Microsoft engineers had a running bridge call during the entire outage, and at one point it hit the maximum of 1,000 participants.

claims.claim: Mühendisler, parçalanmış iç takip sistemleri nedeniyle kesinti sırasında 11 Teams sohbeti üzerinden mesaj alışverişi yapmak zorunda kaldı.

evidence.quote: Microsoft engineers had to exchange messages across 11 Teams chats and reportedly “struggled to maintain a cohesive picture” during the outage because of the fragmented internal tracking systems.
